column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - zero-size link-layout labels: bounds the linker defines (PSYLINK's
# group symbols such as _bss_org), with their retail addresses. They name boundaries, not
# storage, so they never appear in data_identities.tsv; the target relink and the closure
# resolve references to them. A data word relocated against one (a reviewed mips32_candidate
# row naming it, whose target is this address or this address plus a constant addend)
# compares as unresolved-link-label until the current link's .SYM puts the name at this
